metadata.scope: Recover the staging /profile failure where an authenticated admin (valid JWT, freshly logged in) receives MEMBER_SESSION_404 because the server-side GET /me fetch returns HTTP 404. The displayed wording is the MEMBER_SESSION_404 branch in session-error-display.ts (title セッション情報を取得できませんでした / detail アカウント情報を確認できませんでした。再ログインしてください。 / CTA 再ログイン), which is only produced when /me returns HTTP 404. The user-provided JWT decodes to memberId=ce86abba-ba3c-48f4-85b9-9fa09fa1b9ec, email=manjumoto.daishi@senpai-lab.com, isAdmin=true, iat ~8s before the request (fresh Google login). Login success proves the D1 member_identities + consented member_status for this email exist. The api /me route cannot return 404 under valid auth (it returns 200/401/410/500), and 401 would redirect to /login (not observed), so the observed 404 is the API notFoundHandler (UBM-1404 route-not-matched) or a web<->api deploy/route drift. apps/api has NO automated CD (web-cd.yml deploys only apps/web), making api-staging drift structurally possible (S1, leading). The one-cycle fix is defense-in-depth: T01 add structured notFound diagnostics on the API so the data-cause (route-not-matched vs auth vs data) is identifiable from logs alone; T02 add apps/api automated CD (dev->staging, main->production) with a post-deploy /me/healthz 200 + minted-cookie authenticated /me 200 smoke gate (root fix for S1); T03 record route-404 with transport descriptor in web server_fetch_failed; T04 extend the read-only diagnose script to output /me route existence and web<->api deploy parity. No /me path/shape/status change, no apps/api endpoint surface change, no D1 schema, no Google Form, and no /profile UI wording change. Final sub-cause confirmation and staging recovery verification are user-gated Phase 11 steps.

confirmed_facts.summary: Displayed wording is the MEMBER_SESSION_404 branch in session-error-display.ts (title セッション情報を取得できませんでした / CTA 再ログイン)
MEMBER_SESSION_404 is produced only when GET /me returns HTTP status 404 (fetchAuthed throws FetchAuthedError(404) -> safe-fetch codes MEMBER_SESSION_404)
401 redirects to /login via rethrowOn AuthRequiredError; the error screen (no redirect) confirms 404, not 401
User JWT decodes to memberId=ce86abba..., email=manjumoto.daishi@senpai-lab.com, isAdmin=true, iat ~8s before request = fresh Google login
Login success requires fetchSessionResolve to return non-null memberId, proving D1 member_identities + consented member_status for this email exist
The api /me route returns only 200/401/410/500 under valid auth; sessionGuard 401s on missing identity/status, 410s on deleted, provider middleware does not 404
API notFoundHandler returns UBM-1404 with status 404 on route-not-matched; observed 404 is route-not-matched or web<->api infra layer
apps/api has no automated CD; web-cd.yml deploys only apps/web, so api-staging can drift in version/route relative to web
Transport chain (PR #1237) falls back only on ApiTransportError throw for GET/HEAD, never on HTTP error responses, so any transport returning a 404 Response yields MEMBER_SESSION_404

sub_cause_hypotheses.summary: api-staging deploy/route drift: the staging api worker does not route GET /me as source does (manual-deploy lag); leading cause; F-8 is the structural enabler
service-binding path/version mismatch under OpenNext Workers delivering to an unexpected api version/path
(low) admin-specific member data event whose real status is 401/410; inconsistent with observed 404; if confirmed, out of scope -> #1192/#1234

cross_cutting_defects.summary: No automated CD for apps/api -> web (fresh) and api-staging (manual) drift; reinforcing loop R1 that produces /me 404 boundary failures
API notFoundHandler lacks structured data-cause logging, so /me 404 cannot be attributed (route vs auth vs data) from logs alone
